# templateflow

R client for the [TemplateFlow](https://www.templateflow.org/) archive
of neuroimaging templates.

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub:
remotes::install_github("bbuchsbaum/templateflow")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(templateflow)

# List available templates
tf_templates()

# List files for a specific template
tf_ls(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w")

# Download and return path
path <- tf_get(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w")

# Read directly as NIfTI object (requires RNifti or oro.nifti)
img <- tf_get(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w", read = TRUE)

# Return results as a data frame
df <- tf_ls(template = "MNI152Lin", as_df = TRUE)

# Template metadata and citations
tf_get_metadata(template = "MNI152Lin")
tf_get_citations(template = "MNI152NLin2009cAsym", bibtex = TRUE)
```

## Configuration

| Variable                   | Default            | Description                |
|----------------------------|--------------------|----------------------------|
| `TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME`        | Platform cache dir | Override cache location    |
| `TEMPLATEFLOW_AUTOUPDATE`  | `on`               | Auto-update skeleton stubs |
| `TEMPLATEFLOW_USE_DATALAD` | `off`              | Use DataLad backend        |

## CLI

A command-line interface is available via `Rscript`:

``` bash
Rscript -e 'templateflow::tf_cli()' ls MNI152Lin --suffix T1w
Rscript -e 'templateflow::tf_cli()' config
Rscript -e 'templateflow::tf_cli()' get MNI152Lin --res 1 --suffix T1w
```

## Albers theme

This package uses the albersdown theme. Existing vignette theme hooks
are replaced so `albers.css` and local `albers.js` render consistently
on CRAN and GitHub Pages. The palette family is provided via
`params$family` (default ‘teal’). The pkgdown site uses
`template: { package: albersdown }`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`TemplateFlowClient()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/TemplateFlowClient.md)
  : TemplateFlow R client
- [`print(`*`<TemplateFlowClient>`*`)`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/print.TemplateFlowClient.md)
  : Print a TemplateFlowClient
- [`tf_cache_refresh()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cache_refresh.md)
  : Refresh cache layout
- [`tf_cache_scan()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cache_scan.md)
  : Scan cache for problematic files
- [`tf_cache_stats()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cache_stats.md)
  : Cache statistics
- [`tf_cache_update()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cache_update.md)
  : Update template cache
- [`tf_cache_wipe()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cache_wipe.md)
  : Wipe the template cache
- [`tf_cli()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_cli.md)
  : TemplateFlow CLI
- [`tf_client()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_client.md)
  : Get or create the default global TemplateFlow client
- [`tf_datalad_available()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_datalad_available.md)
  : Check if DataLad is available
- [`tf_datalad_get()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_datalad_get.md)
  : Get files from a DataLad dataset
- [`tf_datalad_install()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_datalad_install.md)
  : Install a DataLad dataset
- [`tf_datalad_update()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_datalad_update.md)
  : Update a DataLad dataset
- [`tf_describe()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_describe.md)
  : Describe a template
- [`tf_entities()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_entities.md)
  : List available BIDS entity names
- [`tf_file_extension()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_file_extension.md)
  : Extract compound file extension
- [`tf_get()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_get.md)
  : Fetch template assets (downloading if needed)
- [`tf_get_citations()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_get_citations.md)
  : Retrieve template citations
- [`tf_get_metadata()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_get_metadata.md)
  : Read template metadata
- [`tf_ls()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_ls.md)
  : List template assets
- [`tf_prefetch()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_prefetch.md)
  : Batch prefetch template files
- [`tf_read_file()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_read_file.md)
  : Read a template file into an R object
- [`tf_set_client()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_set_client.md)
  : Set global client
- [`tf_templates()`](https://bbuchsbaum.github.io/templateflow/reference/tf_templates.md)
  : List available templates
